title: Position: General Alignment Has Hit a Ceiling; Edge Alignment Must Be Taken Seriously

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing case studies and previous empirical assessments of large language models (e.g., ChatGPT) across psychological and cultural value dimensions to demonstrate a systemic preference for Western/individualistic norms (WEIRD populations) while marginalizing collectivist norms.

Theoretical and normative evaluation showing how scalar reward optimization (General Alignment) and preference aggregation lead to statistical 'mode collapse' (via Jensen's inequality), which systematically erases minority viewpoints and pluralistic values located in the distribution tails.
